verdict.rationale: AWS ships a first-party template-based IaC service: CloudFormation provisions the resources declared in a template and deletes them all with the stack. It also ships the AWS CDK, an open-source typed framework in TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, and Go whose constructs compose into stacks and deploy through CloudFormation. Stacks imply managed state, and the evidence documents stack create, update, and delete, but nothing documents rollback behaviour. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of rollback and failure semantics, drift and state-management detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
